カズタシンヤ(数田伸也)

segments.text: A cheeky and greedy waitress, who loves money and tries to rip off customers as much as she can.

Her real identity, along with Tesse's, is a terminal of Amaterasu. Her role is to observe people and their doings. In critical situations, she also can interfere in natural course of things, but only as minimal as necessary.
大衆酒場で働いている元気な双子のウェイトレス。
一見おとなしそうだが、息を吸うようにからかってくるのがティナ。見た目そのまま活発で、息を吐くようにからかってくるのがティセである。
基本的に二人揃って歯に衣着せない性分であり、飛び出す言葉のナイフは鋭く無邪気な笑顔で相手の心を抉りにかかる。最近の標的は女好きと散在癖の激しいグレイ。甘い言葉で大注文へと誘導してがっぽりカモっているとのこと。
二匹の小悪魔は今日も元気に、愛らしく、馬鹿な男を沈めるのだろう。

cast.originalCharacterName: ラグナ・スカイフィールド

segments.text: Ragna is the partner and other half (in a metaphoric sense) of Misaki, a mercenary warrior who was once instructed by Dainslief (from Silverio Trinity). He has an immense capacity for both love and hate, and he can be classified - by the Silverio universe's standards - as a fanatical martyr of the Light. However, unlike most such individuals, he has a solid recognition that, as someone who can only move forward, that he is somehow broken inside, and he has no illusions that his prowess as a warrior makes him something glorious or great. He, in partnership with Misaki, is the Godslayer Nidhogg, the evil dragon-serpent that chews at the roots of Yggdrasil.

A series of events conspire to manifest Ragna Skyfield and Misaki Kujou on earth in place of Tina and Tesse Kujou, the humanoid AIs who serve as the living cameras of the Yamato. Having lost his memory and finding the similarly amnesiac Misaki next to him in the grassy field, they end up walking to the nearest village within Canterbury borders to find food and work.

When the village they spent four years of their existence in is destroyed and the inhabitants turned into crystallised trees by the Gods' experiment, Ragna manifests Fimbulvetr for the first time together with Misaki. When Glenfarth and Ragna clash, the resulting impact sends Ragna and Misaki out of Canterbury and into Antalya lands. They eventually end up at the Liberati household, and their quest for revenge together with Cecile begins.

In addition to his ability to manifest Fimbulvetr, Ragna is also capable of manifesting red crystal Astrea no bigger than knives. This is of great interest to Ouka and the other Gods as they have spent a thousand years finding a way to allow others apart from themselves to crystallise Astrea.

His true identity is an avatar of Yamato imprinted with Kujou Haruto's knowledge and expertise, akin to how an amoeba divides into two perfectly identical selves. The same principle allows to Kujou Misaki with Misaki Kujou as her "parent".
アンタルヤ商業連合国の傭兵にして、終焉吼竜の異名で知られる星辰奏者。そして、神祖滅殺の運命を担う本作の主人公。
一見すると素っ気なく、常に自然体を崩さないゆえ冷たい印象を抱かれがちだが、その根は真面目な常識人。非常に義理堅い性格であり、一度受けた恩は何があっても忘れず、信頼には倍をもって応えるべきだと手を差し伸べることを厭わない。
そのため仲間や家族を大切に思っている反面、受けた仇にも義理堅く、報復を与えることを戸惑わない。目には目を歯には歯をの言葉通り、四年前に故郷を壊滅させたグレンファルト、並びに神祖全員を家族であるミサキと共に必ず討つと誓っている。
すべては地獄を超えた先で、笑顔の花を咲かせるために。
彼という希望の殉教者が来訪したその時、神々に終焉を呼ぶ逢魔ヶ時は幕開ける。

Ragna's partner and other half (better half?). Together they are the Godslayer. Misaki is, by nature, a simple country girl who would probably be happier milking cows than fighting a secret war against the evil that destroyed her and Ragna's home. However, she can be cold when the situation requires it. Like Ragna, she is a mercenary, but she is far less skilled than he is.

In regular battle, she wields a short sword and can materialise energy blades which she projects at her foes. When she changes her appearance into Tsukuyomi, her wounds create Fimbulvetr for Ragna to wield against the immortals.

A terminal of Kujou Misaki, the central overseer of Yamato and Glenfarth's sister. She and Ragna were manifested in the place of Canterbury's Tesse and Tina due to a combination of independent events. She serves a role for Ragna that is identical to that of Vendetta for Zephyr and Nagisa for Ashley
アンタルヤ商業連合国の傭兵にして、ラグナの家族兼相棒として行動を共にする星辰奏者。
無邪気にして、人懐っこい犬のように天真爛漫。しかして時に計算高く、合理的で容赦がないという相反する二面性を矛盾なく同居させた、可憐な少女。
物心ついた瞬間からラグナとは家族同然に育ってきた関係であり、切っても切り離せない相手だと双方共に想っている。
特にミサキは彼が絶望を覆して希望を見せた経験から、献身の念が非常に強い。少しでもラグナの力となるためなら、どんな苦難も恐れないが……しかし。
グレンファルト然り、他の神祖然り、彼女の名と姿を知った途端、まるで知人や亡霊を目にしたように瞠目するその真実は何なのか。
そこに形容難い不安の念を抱えながら、ミサキ・クジョウは毅然と運命に立ち向かう。唯一無二の大切な家族、誇るべき神殺しと共に。

segments.text: A scion of the Liberati, one of the Ten Families of the ultra-capitalist oligarchy of Antalya. Four years living and working together with Ragna and Misaki have forged an unbreakable bond between the trio which surpasses a mere employer-employee relationship. Under her smooth, pragmatic manner burns a hatred that rivals or even potentially surpasses that of Ragna and Misaki.

Her clan have a trading relationship with Canterbury for over nine generations. Much of the capital's High Street has shops which are directly affiliated with her clan. The logistics network commanded by the Liberati with respect to Canterbury's Capital is unrivalled in Antalya.

Cecile is head over heels in love with Ragna and makes no attempt to disguise romantic overtures towards him. Ragna on the other hand is consumed by the burden of Ragnarok and has not responded to her overtures positively up to the point where the story begins.

Cecile's family, the Liberati, are the descendants of Sumeragi's first Disciple, Edward, and have inherited the genetic memory and vengeful hatred of their ancestor for him and his fellows for almost a thousand years. Cecile, like all members of her family, was exposed to this hatred in the womb, and her bloodlust to see Sumeragi die was her first emotion. It is only after meeting Ragna and Misaki that she starts to think of the future beyond the deaths of the gods.

Cecile wields twin daggers and her energy-drain ability allows her to regenerate grievous injuries. Her ability is more effective the more crowded and chaotic the battlefield is. Under the right circumstances, her energy drain ability is so effective she can easily take on foes even Ragna and Jace have trouble dealing with.
アンタルヤ商業連合国を統べる十氏族が一つ、リベラーティ海運業のお嬢様にしてラグナとミサキの雇用主。一族をあげた神祖滅殺の協力者。
優雅で、見目麗しく、商魂たくましい才媛だが、それはあくまで表の顔。薔薇のように華麗な笑顔の裏側では、神祖に対する暗い憎悪が溶岩のように煮え滾っている。
つまり生粋の復讐者であり、彼女は己が衝動を指して“呪怨継ぎ”と呼んでいるが詳細は不明。
しかし何も、常に殺意が溢れているわけではなく、信頼している相手には素直に照れたり笑顔や弱音を見せたりする、年頃の女の子らしい一面も。
とりわけミサキとは親友同士と仲が良く、雇用関係の上下を抜きによく二人でじゃれあいながら、彼女を巻き込んでラグナにアプローチを仕掛けようとしている。

An Inquisitor of the Holy Church of Canterbury, an Amatsu (descendant of the Japanese who in the Silverio world have a high probability of natural-born talent), and an Esperanto. She is the collaborator within the ranks of the Church. She has a venomous tongue and both friend and foe know she cannot be taken lightly.

In addition to her duties as Inquisitor, which include the unmasking of heretics and traitors and their execution, she is also the administrator of the "Expatriate Quarter", the one area where foreign visitors are allowed to spend the night in Canterbury's capital.

She has been friends with Patricia for years, to the point they call each other "Pattie" and "Angie". Although she is weary of Patricia's propensity to needle her in public regarding her personality and bust size, she treasures Patricia more than anything else and will go out of her way to ensure her friend is not involved in pitched battles against the Godslayer.

Like all Actleir family members, she is Izana and Ouka's child and destined to bear Izana's child herself one day. Unlike most of her family, she loathes the idea and desires nothing more than the death of the gods who birthed her.

Her staff Laevatein is the catalyst which powers her ability to project flames strong enough to burn just about anything. Her bloodline accentuates her powers, but at the same time her powers are destined to be no more than an inferior replica of her parent Izana's.
カンタベリー聖教皇国の内部粛清機関、聖座信仰監視局に属する葬歌司祭こと通称、執行官の末席に数えられる少女。同時に神へ面従腹背しながら、ラグナ達と盟を結ぶ叛逆者。
まるでよく出来た人形のように整った容姿と、外見年齢にそぐわないミステリアスさを滲ませる雰囲気が特徴。世を斜めから見ているのか、上品な口調には常に微量の毒が含まれており、それが油断ならぬ印象を敵味方問わず与えている。
本来は神祖の配下でありながら、弓引くという茨道を選んだのは国の行く末を案じたがためとのこと。
だが、その裏では自身の身体を流れる血と、授けられた宿業からの解放を望んでいるのは……協力者であるジェイス以外に未だ知る者はいない。
パトリシアとは互いにパティ、アンジーと愛称で呼び合う仲。
能天気な友人への扱いは一見ぞんざいだが、その実とても大切に思っている。信頼できる彼女を神祖や聖教国の真実から遠ざけているのは、ひとえにアンジェリカの不器用な友情ゆえなのだろう。

segments.text: The leader of the terrorist organization Full Metal Gigas, fanatics who believe becoming a cyborg is a form of transcedence. In many ways a typical Fanatic of the Light, who will keep going forward, destroying everything that gets in his way until he reaches the future. He is the second Godslayer. He confesses he accidentally blew off his own penis when he over-stressed his cybernetics.

Having grown up as a delinquent in Adler, he joined the military in an attempt to show up Valzeride, who beat him down once in the past. However, as he served in the military, single-mindedly fulfilling his role as a soldier, he suddenly found himself confronted by a small child who thanked him for saving her village. It was this, in combination with Valzeride's affirmation that it was his actions that saved that girl's hope for the future, that convinced him that even someone like him, someone who only has a talent for warfare, can give hope to and protect others. He is a husband and father of thirteen children, five of them his own, eight of them adopted battlefield orphans. He is also a Third Generation Masei. Unlike many Fanatics of Light, he knows that he can't do everything on his own and he is quite willing to pass the baton to someone else when he can no longer continue.
新興機械化兵団、機甲巨人化創星録を率いる首魁。ラグナに続くもう一人の“神殺し”。
豪放磊落にして大胆不敵な戦闘者。全身に超重度の人体改造を施している最新鋭のサイボーグであると共に、現状、ラグナ以外で神祖滅殺を実行できる唯一の存在に他ならない。
聖教国へ執拗な侵略行為を重ねていることから、血に飢えた破壊魔として悪名を轟かせているが……
実際は面倒見が良く、覚悟や決意を重んじ、認めた相手には敵対者にも敬意を払うと、実に気持ちのいい好人物。
とりわけ、『力とは他者の涙を拭うために使うべし』と公言してはばからないなど、似合わぬ理念をたびたび口にすることも。
総じて謎の多い男だが、味方にすれば頼もしく、敵に回せば手の付けられない最終兵器と化すことだけは恐らく間違いないだろう。

cast.originalCharacterName: グレンファルト・フォン・ヴェラチュール

segments.text: The nemesis of Ragna and Misaki. He immediately claims responsibility for the destruction of their village and the conversion of its inhabitants into crystallised Astrea. Although he is the first to witness the manifestation of the Godslayer, he does not disclose the knowledge to his compatriots immediately.
Although his official title is Head of the Paladins, the other Gods look to him as their leader in decision making.
Currently, he has one Apostle, William Bergshrine. Bergshrine serves as his right-hand and living sword to use against his foes.

Before the Catastrophe, he was Kujou Haruto. A member of the Japanese research team in charge of the dimensional reactor. When it was sabotaged and his sister left his side, he swore he would use his immortality to find a way to reunite with her.

He has spent a thousand years training in fields he was weak in, to the point there is no one other than his compatriots and William Bergshrine who are his equal in battle. Although he taught Bergshrine swordplay, he confesses his Apostle has far surpassed the effort he and his compatriots devoted a thousand years of effort into while in his forties.

Although his compatriots are happy to proceed with the plan to supplant Amaterasu and recreate the old world prior to the Catastrophe, Glenfarth has no intention of stopping there. His real intention is to ascend as a Sphere and create a world Asgard where ALL of humanity can become Spheres themselves and live the life they wish without limitations.
Sharing the same origin, Kujou Haruto, he with Ragna are recognized as the same person by Amaterasu. Still, Glenfarth was recognized as "master" entity, while Ragna as "slave" entity.
千年の時を生きる完全無欠な不死者——“神祖”の一柱。革新と破壊に長けた絶対神。
表の立場は聖騎士の最高位、カンタベリー聖教皇国守護騎士団を統べる総代聖騎士を務める男。
正真正銘、西暦の終わりから存在してきた怪物中の怪物であり、かつて人間時代は九条榛士と呼ばれていたが、大破壊で力及ばず最愛の人物を失った過去を持つ。無力な自分自身との決別も籠め、今の名前を新たに付けたのはその時の慟哭から。
刻まれた喪失を覚悟に変え、膨大な時を歩んだためか。果て無く成長を遂げ続けた結果として、グレンファルトの精神に人間らしい脆さや弱さは、今や欠片も残っていない。
人知の及ばぬ在り方はまさしく人外、神の有り様。そんな彼がミサキに対して執着を見せる理由は杳として明かされないが、しかし強大な運命の車輪が止まることはないだろう。
逢魔ヶ時か——神天地か
掲げた理想の未来を目指し、大神素戔王は挑み続ける。無限の希望も絶望も、重ねたすべてを力として。

掲げた理想の未来を目指し、大神素戔王（ヴェラチュール）は挑み続ける。無限の希望も絶望も、重ねたすべてを力として。
The Pontiff of the Canterbury kingdom and ostensibly its ruler. Despite his youthful appearance, he has mastered the art of manipulating others for his own ends.
Pre-Catastrophe, he was Sumeragi Yuuya. A prodigy who mastered the concept of astrophysics before he was 12, he was handpicked by the Japanese Government to join the research team headed by Ouka.

His youth and inexperience made him the least prepared to mentally cope with the fallout. In the early years of Canterbury's founding he relied on his first apostle Edward to build the foundations of the kingdom. Edward proved too talented and perceptive; he foresaw what would become of Canterbury and raised a rebellion against the Four Gods. Without a means to nullify immortality, Edward's rebellion was crushed.

Disheartened by the rebellion, Sumeragi departed Canterbury and wandered what was left of the world. Eventually he met his wife and stayed with her until she died of old age. This gave him the resolve to aid his compatriots in their attempts to restore the world to its pre-Catastrophe state.

Sumeragi unlike his compatriots does not fight his foes directly. Instead, he shares his divine strength to trusted soldiers, and later the mass-production model of the Planets. His talent as a puppeteer of military robots is unmatched, combined with his ability to share his powers more efficiently than his peers.
千年の時を生きる完全無欠な不死者——“神祖”の一柱。天津の秩序を万民に敷く大国主。
表の立場はカンタベリー聖教皇国の象徴にして、極東黄金教の最高権威たる教皇に即位している。
第二次性徴前の少年という幼い外見に反し、性格は老獪で合理的の極み。これは多感な思春期に西暦崩壊を経験し、新時代の黎明という激動の時代を駆け抜けたことに起因している。
多くの信頼と裏切りを経た結果、スメラギは最も大衆の心理誘導と人心掌握に長けた神祖として成長。十世紀の時を経た今、臣民を操る手腕にもはや淀みもなければ逡巡もない。
そう、何万の人間を何百年もの長い時間……大規模な実験の礎にしようとも。
赤子や老人の区別もなく、地獄のような光景を何億回と生み出しても。天使のような彼の微笑が翳ることなど一切ない。
世界樹創生のためならば、聖教国すべての民を理想の薪木とくべるだろう。なぜならスメラギという現人神こそ、大衆が祈りを捧げる大和の御心なのだから。

cast.originalCharacterName: イザナ・フォン・ザンブレイブ

segments.text: The head of the Xnbrave clan and Rufus Xnbrave's wife. Outside of public knowledge, she is one of the Four Gods who rule Canterbury and is also the head of its special forces, the Ibuyashuu.
Extremely open with regards to sex, her range includes males and females. She can act as the chaste and loving spouse one minute, a scheming black widow the next.

Her name prior to the Catastrophe was Kamishiro Izana. A member of the research team working on the dimensional reactor, she became immortal after the Catastrophe together with her companions. A virtual reality junkie, the loss of that technology in the post-Catastrophe world is one reason why she is so keen on sex for pleasure. Sex is also used for procreation as the Gods resort to inbreeding to increase the number of talented pawns they can deploy to manage the country.
Izana's power works on a very simple concept; she draws energy from a higher dimension and expels it in devastating bursts using cannons shaped like circular crystals.
千年の時を生きる完全無欠な不死者——“神祖”の一柱。他愛と自愛を掌握する地母神。
表の立場は、聖教国の名家ザンブレイブの女党首にして、ルーファス・ザンブレイブの愛妻。更に裏の顔として神祖直属の特殊実働部隊、暗部・伊賦夜衆の長を担っている。
表と裏できっぱり別れた二面性を持ち、新婚夫婦を演じる際は柔和で物腰柔らかく女性的な仕草が目立つ。対して有事は言動が男性的になり、あらゆる面で硬質化。普段の温厚さはなりを潜め、冷徹な顔を覗かせる。
人間の俗的な部分、とりわけ性に対して非常に寛容。その愛情は男女問わず向けられており、気に入った相手がいれば誘惑して褥を共にすることもしばしば。婚姻後は夫ルーファスも交えて乱れるのが常態化している……と。
ここまでなら貴族の火遊びで済む範疇だが、しかしそれはイザナの本質を封印する安全弁のようなもの。
彼女の真の危険性は、愛や情で懐柔できぬと見切った瞬間暴かれる。女性的な表情が剥がれ落ちたら最後、超常の神威を顕わにあらゆる生命を蹂躙して闇に葬ることを躊躇わない。
服従には、快楽に満ちた極楽を。
叛逆には、絶対的な無慈悲極まる絶滅を。
イザナは人間の情を慈しみ、悲喜交々をどれも等しく味わいながら玩弄する。その摩訶不思議な性質を見誤ったが最後、愛すべき家畜として魂の一片まで使い潰されてしまうだろう。

One of the Four Gods who rule Canterbury, she is the head of the kingdom's Astral Research Division. Ruthlessly logical, she will only derive conclusions based on hard data, instead of relying on nebulous concepts like the "gut feeling" of her compatriots Sumeragi and Glenfarth.
Her name prior to the Catastrophe was Konohana Ouka. The director of the research team comprising the Kujo siblings, Izana and Sumeragi.

Like her compatriots, she finds violence a sub-optimal solution to resolving an impasse. Nevertheless, she has spent a thousand years overcoming her weaknesses and dislikes. Her power is to increase her physical capabilities using crystallised Astral, to the point her power output surpasses even Glenfarth's. Her fighting strategy is to kill her foes using her fists, or to detach her body parts and detonate them like a suicide bomber (which doesn't impact her fighting ability as she regenerates the limbs almost instantaneously).
千年の時を生きる完全無欠な不死者——“神祖”の一柱。森羅を読み解く叡智の神。
表の立場はカンタベリー聖教皇国の星辰体研究機関、聖座典礼秘蹟庁の長官にして枢機卿を務めている。
無駄を嫌い、数式を好み、理路整然とした現象を重視する研究者らしい研究者。根っからの探求の徒であり、千年前は星辰体研究チームの主任だったという経歴を持つ。
そして今もその気質と才は変わっておらず、聖教国という神の作った実験場でオウカと無念なプロジェクトは一つたりとも存在しない。
つまり神祖の手で積み上げられた数多の犠牲は、間接的に彼女の頭脳へ帰結していると言えるだろう。大局的に極めて重要な立場を占めており、神祖滅殺を目指す上でも放置してはならない相手だが、しかし。
だからといって、忘れてはならない。オウカは科学者である以前に、絶大な神威を秘める不死身の魔神ということを。
神祖は皆、口を揃えてこう断言する。単純な戦闘力、そして出力に限定すればオウカ・鳳・アマツこそ最強の神祖であると。
かつて煮え湯を飲まされた経験からか。精神力で世の理を覆す所業、ないしそれを可能とする希少種を“光狂い”と呼称して、辟易した感情を向けている。

cast.characterName: リチャード・ザンブレイブ
cast.originalCharacterName: リチャード・ザンブレイブ

segments.text: The kind-hearted younger brother of Rufus, who was raised to knighthood solely based on his brother's advancement. He admires and practically worships his older brother, and he wants nothing more than to repay his debt to society and his brother.

Upon Rufus's death, he swears revenge against the Godslayer responsible. However, he also befriends Ragna, unaware of his true identity. He is conflicted by his desire to avenge the older brother he idolises, and the fear that his best friend Ragna is truly the killer he is searching for.

Even less capable of fighting than his mundane older brother, Richard's strength (according to Ragna) is the immunity of his soul to the corruption of hatred. Any fighting capability he gains is granted externally; his manifestation as the Kusanagi blade is a product of a dual contract with Glenfarth and Izana or Ragna's gift of the red crystal.
カンタベリー聖教皇国第一軍団・金剛騎士団の末席に数えられる騎士。
他者への思いやりに溢れるが、少しばかり気の弱さが目立つ青年。特に目立った才能や特異性を持っておらず、強いて言えば優しさだけが取り柄という至って普通の人物であり、星辰奏者の適性も当然まったく備えていない。
騎士職ではあるものの、それは兄ルーファスの婿入りを機に名家ザンブレイブへ迎え入れられたから。自身が七光りと罵倒されるのは構わないが、尊敬する兄の足を引っ張ってはならないという一念で、リチャードは日夜彼なりの精進を重ねている。
本来ならそうして平穏な人生を送るはずだった青年は、しかし“神殺し”という災禍により、過酷な運命へと誘われていく羽目になる。
まさに終わりなき復讐の連鎖。許さない、必ず仇を取るのだと。リチャード・ザンブレイブは形見の剣を握りしめ、重い鎧を身に纏う。
魂を憎しみで染める才能など、これっぽっちもないままに。
誰かを信じる優しさ以外、涙が出るほど何の素質のない青年は……見る無残な復讐者として破滅の道を歩んでいく。
約束された末路に向かい、血反吐と涙を振りまきながら。

cast.originalCharacterName: ウィリアム・ベルグシュライン

segments.text: A nearly emotionless warrior who has reached the pinnacle of swordsmanship. Easily the strongest Paladin and Disciple. He is the Apostle of Glenfarth.

A man who is the embodiment of being 'gifted'. He has an immeasurable talent for battle, to the point where he can master sword techniques another master might take a lifetime to take in in the blink of an eye. He is rational to the core, seeing his only purpose in existence to serve as a sword for his master.

Bergshrine is so talented that his combat ability surpasses even his master and the Gods while in his 40s. Befitting the sword of Veratyr, his loyalty is to Glenfarth alone and he will not hesitate to cut down the other Gods should the order be given.

His powers allow him to extend his sword slashes as far as his eye can see. Although it's no more than an extension of his attack range, his natural talent and skill make him the perfect living weapon for Glenfarth's desires. Even Jace acknowledges Adler's Murasame given immortality and Astral powers might not be Bergshrine's equal on the battlefield.
カンタベリー聖教皇国第一軍団・金剛騎士団団長を務める聖騎士にして、神祖に仕える“使徒”の一人。
位階はI。騎士としての名は斬空真剣。
常に寡黙で冷静沈着な、滅私奉公という言葉を体現したような男。いかな命令にも私見を挟まず黙々と、しかし完璧に遂行する在り方は、騎士というより旧日本に語られる侍や武士——あるいは刀剣のそれに近い。
そうした人間性の薄さと反比例するかのごとく戦闘能力は無類無双。心技体のすべてが隔絶した域にあり、聖教皇国千年の歴史において文句なく頂点に君臨している戦闘特化型の使徒である。
育ての親兼主君たるグレンファルトからは全幅の信頼を向けられており、ベルグシュラインもまたそんな主に応えるべく日々の精進を欠かさぬと、主従仲は極めて良好。それら忠義と義心を武器に、神殺しを阻む最大の壁として彼は立ちはだかるだろう。
カンタベリー聖教皇国第一軍団・金剛騎士団（ダイアモンド）団長を務める聖騎士（パラディン）にして、神祖に仕える“使徒”の一人。

A scion of the Amatsu whose bloodline is strong, he is Ouka's apostle and incredibly gifted at research. Despite his abilities, he is neither arrogant nor ambitious. If there is a flaw in this exceptionally talented individual, it is his desire to form true friendships with others.

He is betrothed to Rina as per the long-standing custom of the Amatsu and Kirigakure clans. Although he does not share her absolute devotion to him, he is happy with his arrangement and will go ahead with the wedding ceremony when the time is ripe.

Despite his prodigious talent at research and supporting his fellow Paladins from the rear, Syu wants nothing more than to fight with his fists at the front lines. A classic case of personal desire completely at odds with natural talent, his frustration threatens to boil over as the struggle between the Godslayer and the Gods reaches its climax.

When he defends a dying Rina from Jace with his bare hands, he seizes the opportunity to fulfil his lifelong desire even though he is fully aware he is no match for Adler's Zodiac in hand-to-hand combat. Although he is telling the truth when he says he needs no excuse to use his fists to protect his fiancee, it appears that motivation is secondary to his great desire to settle conflicts like a man.

His powers allow him to manipulate the elements and more through his manifested magic circles. Years of living together with Rina have developed an almost telepathic understanding between the two on the battlefield. In addition, he is also talented at commanding machines although not in the same league as Sumeragi.
カンタベリー聖教皇国の星辰体研究機関、聖座典礼秘蹟庁に属する若き大司祭にして神祖に仕える“使徒”の一人。
日系の血を色濃く継いだ貴種であり、その中でも研究者として群を抜いた素養を見せる優秀な青年。先天的な身分差が幅を利かせる聖教国でも異例の速さで頭角を現し、純粋な能力評価で使徒に選ばれた実績を持つが、掴んだ栄光と立場を傘に着る様子はまったくない。
彼は常に増長せず、浅慮に走らず、主君への貢献を第一に考える。それを自然な行動と捉えているため、綻びが生じる気配はまったくない。
されどそういった、欠点らしい欠点を持たない反動か。能力差や立場を抜きにした気兼ねない友人関係に餓えている節があり、壁のない付き合いを周囲に求める一面も。それがまだ、年若いシュウの見せる些細な願いなのだろう。
従者であるリナは慣習で定められた許婚だが、そこに不満は一切ない。時が来れば結ばれるだろうと、特に気負いなく考えている。

Ouka's apostle. She is one of Canterbury's paladins and is assigned to serve as Syu's bodyguard. Older than Syu by two years, she is another of the Kirigakure clan whose destiny is to serve the Amatsu for life. From young, she has served him and is his betrothed, wedded life is something she has looked forward to with great anticipation.
Despite knowing Syu from a young age, she has never realised his burning desire to fight at the frontline the same way she does.
Her powers revolve around sonic vibration. Unlike Zephyr Colerain, she can enchant her weapons to deliver devastating blows that can destroy just about anything.
カンタベリー聖教皇国の星辰体の聖騎士であると共に、貴種にして主君たるシュウ・欅・アマツの護衛を担う専従騎士。
位階はIII。騎士としての名は震砕角笛。
如何なる時も声を荒げず、おしとやかで慎み深い。それでいて男を立てながら、困難には凛と立ち向かう気丈さを秘めるという、旧歴における日本女子の理想像——大和撫子を体現した少女がリナである。
アマツに仕えるキリガクレのお役目上、二つ下のシュウとは彼が物心つく前からの付き合い。
それゆえ幼少時から醸造された忠誠心は鉄より硬く、堅牢堅固。主とは逆に肉体面の素養を煥発させ、立ちはだかる不遜な敵を一切許さず撃滅する。
慣習で定められたシュウの許婚であり、彼女にとってそれはまさに約束された福音に他ならない。はしたないゆえ貞淑に隠しているが、訪れる薔薇色の未来を一日千秋の想いで待ち焦がれている。

A coder and a member of the Japanese research team in charge of the dimensional reactor. The team leader was Konohana Ouka, and the other members were Kamishiro Izana, Sumeragi Yuuya and Kujou Misaki.

When the reactor was sabotaged and the Catastrophe occurred, the most of his body was absorbed by Astral and become a data in Amaterasu. After thousands years, it has manifested in the Earth as Ragna Nidhogg. But a small part of Haruto's body, a part of the head and brain, has remained in Earth and was transferred in England along with other team members except Misaki. One who recovered from it has become Glenfarth von Veratyr.

cast.characterName: ルーファス・ザンブレイブ
cast.originalCharacterName: ルーファス・ザンブレイブ

segments.text: Sumeragi's Apostle and a Paladin of the Diamond Knights. While he presents a brave and noble front to those around him, he is in fact a normal, if somewhat self-absorbed young man who has found himself caught up in the web of aristocratic politics, pretending at being something he isn't.

An utterly mundane innkeeper whose only goal in life was a quiet existence, he is identified as an exceptionally useful pawn by Sumeragi. His cover story as the first commoner to enter the ranks of the Diamond Knights is useful for pacifying the masses by giving them something to look up to.

Despite his designated role as the mascot of the Gods, Rufus increasingly grows dissatisfied with his lot. Unfortunately his mundane nature and preference for the easy option doom him to fulfil Sumeragi's prophecy; that he will never progress or go beyond where he is.

As the newest member of the immortal apostles, he is the first target for the Godslayer and his allies to confirm Fimbulvetr is up to the task. Had Ragna not succeeded in killing him, the alliance with Angelica would not have been cemented.
In battle, he relies on his god-given strength, immortality and the power to summon lightning.

cast.characterName: パトリシア・フォン・クイーングラス
cast.originalCharacterName: パトリシア・フォン・クイーングラス

segments.text: A good-hearted, if foolish, girl who is Angelica's only friend. She teases Angelica to the point Angelica resorts to physical violence to shut her up. She and Angelica go back a long way, both of them refer to each other by their affectionate nicknames "Pattie" and "Angie".

She is Galahad's (from Silverio Trinity) niece. She first met Angelica at a party and resolved to break through her antisocial aura. She quickly realised Angelica was hiding something from her and spent years trying to discern what it was. Although she has yet to figure out what Angelica is hiding, her efforts have given her perception which is more than effective against most people.

Her powers manipulate gravity. Although she excels in range and persistence, her powers are poor in terms of enchantment and interference. Because of this, she is also affected when she activates her powers. To overcome this, her custom-made rifle fires bullets which serve as a medium to channel her powers at the point of impact.
